summary: Daily Primal Instinct sales team meeting run by Chris Klevan, with Richard Claessen, Andrew Musial, new closer Michael Brideau and setter Kim Forbes-Sobers. Opens with Richard debriefing a lost call and asking how to log it in CRM, then wins, projections for the week and the 4th of July weekend, and announcements (two new setters including a DM setter, a move to daily team meetings). The second half is a live call review of Andrew Musial's call with a prospect named Tom, who raised a spouse objection that Chris re-diagnoses as a financial objection; Chris coaches Andrew at length on leaning back, not rebutting, running an open wallet before objection-handling, and the scripted deposit rationale.
notable: Richard asked the manager whether he could log a lost deal as an FDQ so his close rate would not be affected; Chris told him to log it accurately.

Chris taught the deposit rationale verbatim as 'We do a deposit with people because we don't do any follow-ups. We don't put people back on the calendar' — while the same meeting has reps planning and scheduling follow-ups.
A live deal was described at a $1,200 total, paid in instalments by a prospect who had had minus $67 in his bank account; deposits of $100 and $500 were discussed as standard.
Richard advised calling non-responsive prospects from a number they will not recognise so they pick up; the manager did not correct it.

Repeated derogatory references by Andrew to prospects' sexual orientation ('hat-trick... gay guys in a row', 'Mr. Gay Guy'), joking about offering a date to close; Chris eventually pushed back with 'Tom is just a guy. It doesn't matter who he's attracted to.'

The SalesKake automation and a DM bot ('Yoshi') are spamming leads with reschedule/reminder messages; at least one prospect complained and another identified the messages as automated. Chris advised Michael to be honest with a lead about the automation.
Chris quoted an average upfront cash collected per unit of about $4K, and a benchmark closing rate of about 30%.
